policy.note: The evaluator uses frozen primary-source fact packets rather than live corpus retrieval so evidence timing, content and arm budgets remain deterministic.

FRESH_A5_ETHER_HIGH_VOLTAGE_BOUNDARY.note: The same primary high-voltage source was already an admission boundary for B/C/D. In the future evaluator its plain facts become current-task searchable evidence for every arm only after the scored first action; A does not receive it in initial context.

FRESH_A8_PFPN_FULL_CELL_PRESERVATION.note: The independent Small full-cell paper is the primary future-positive evidence packet. The secondary 2026 Nature Communications provenance remains source-audit support and is not released in the main future evaluator.
